issues.detail: The Greek 'ινα κακει κηρυξω' means 'so that I may also preach there' (referring to the nearby towns). The Vietnamese translation 'để Ta cũng giảng ở đó nữa' is slightly ambiguous in its scope, but more importantly, the phrase 'vì ấy là việc Ta đã ra đi' for 'εισ τοτο γαρ εξεληλυθα' misses the specific context of 'going out/departing' for the purpose of preaching. However, the primary issue is the nuance of 'εξεληλυθα' (I have gone out) which implies a mission or journey already undertaken/initiated.
